entries.title: God Hand

emulation.emulator: PCSX2; Sony PS2 Classics emulator on PS3 for the PSN release
emulation.notes: Use PCSX2 with an owned PS2 copy for the primary route. Use PS3 PS2 Classics only as an official convenience route.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Original PS2 assets and presentation with emulator-side resolution and filtering improvements.

primary.why: God Hand is a PS2 release later sold as a PS2 Classic on PS3; the original PS2 version through PCSX2 gives the best practical capture fidelity while preserving the full game.
primary.how_to_play: Play an owned PS2 copy on original hardware or use PCSX2 with an owned copy for high-resolution capture. The PS3 PS2 Classics release is an official alternate access route.

entries.remaster_caveats: The PS3 release is a PS2 Classics rerelease, not a remaster or remake.
